message: SPEC 5.3 asks for two negative and two positive similarity pairs (one band per language pairing), but cfg() refuses them ("cleanroom.similarity.pairs needs exactly one pair with role negative (found 2)") and every tool, kukulu_status included, then fails; the planner had to drop SPEC's two Rust-vs-C control pairs to get a loadable config. Separately, the title-derived flight slug (cleanlz4) collided with the existing docs/flights/cleanlz4 archive, so the skill's slug rule had to be overridden by hand.
